briefing.headline: US-China AI chip export controls tighten as frontier labs race toward 2027 AGI targets

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple labs reporting progress on multimodal agents. Compute constraints and export controls are reshaping global alliances while safety concerns mount over autonomous systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 achieves 92% on GPQA, Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus with extended context, Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3, while xAI and DeepSeek push open-weight alternatives amid regulatory scrutiny.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators; Microsoft and Google announce new $50B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona targeting 2027 scale-up.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls successfully delay Chinese frontier model parity beyond 2028 or accelerate indigenous chip breakthroughs?
